steps.title: Create Project Metadata
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json and api_schema.json with backend details and notes collection schema.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Script
steps.description: Create build.gradle with correct compile SDK 34, target SDK 34, Java 8 options, and standard dependencies configuration.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Setup AndroidManifest.xml with required Internet permission, and activities configuration using standard Material style.

steps.title: Create Drawable Layout Resources
steps.description: Create card, button, and input field backgrounds to ensure a beautiful modern UI without AppCompat or MaterialComponents.

steps.title: Design Login Layout
steps.description: Create activity_login.xml with fields for Sign Up, Log In, and Forgot Password (OTP via Gmail workflow).

steps.title: Design Notes Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml layout to show categories filter, live search bar, notes statistics calculation view, notes list, and floating add button.

steps.title: Design Note Editor Layout
steps.description: Create activity_note_editor.xml allowing users to write/edit notes, select dynamic categories, and delete selected notes.

steps.title: Design Custom Notes List Item
steps.description: Create note_list_item.xml showing the beautiful structured notes card containing title, content preview, category chip, and date.

steps.title: Develop Java Notes Model Class
steps.description: Implement Note.java to encapsulate note attributes like ID, title, content, category, and update timestamp.

steps.title: Develop Reusable Backend API Client
steps.description: Create BackendApi.java using native HttpURLConnection to support Registration, Authentication, Reset Password (OTP), and robust CRUD operations.

steps.title: Implement Login Activity
steps.description: Implement LoginActivity.java to handle secure user sessions, automatic log-in, email signup, and Forgot Password dialog via Gmail OTP flow.

steps.title: Implement Notes Dashboard Activity
steps.description: Implement MainActivity.java containing real-time search, category spinner filters, local statistics counts, list updates, and logouts.

steps.title: Implement Note Editor Activity
steps.description: Implement NoteEditorActivity.java handling saving changes, deleting entries, and syncing modifications with the cloud backend.

steps.title: Building SmartNotes
steps.description: Perform final build validation of the completed project using the compile environments and standard system assets.
